_note: Real sample data from the Music League bot DB for Claude Designer mockups of the Theme Research song-metadata surface. Titles/artists/submitters/points and all metadata are actual values.
coverage_note: Completed rounds (below) are well-backfilled: popularity_proxy, audio (bpm/key/scale/energy/duration) and lyrics presence are ~fully covered; genre TAGS are only ~30% covered — the real sparse field to design around. A FRESH or in-progress round (e.g. a voting-phase round just imported) starts with NO audio and NO lyrics/tags — only popularity may exist — because those come from background queue jobs that run after import. So design the 'not analyzed yet' state (brief D3) for: (a) rows missing tags, (b) rows missing audio (see partial_coverage_examples), and (c) a brand-new row where audio+lyrics+tags are all pending.

field_notes.obscurity: 0-100, = 100 - popularity_proxy. Higher = more obscure. Buckets below (matches digest Tastemaker).
field_notes.has_lyrics: presence-only (true/false/null). Raw lyrics text is not stored; word/line counts exist in DB.
field_notes.tags: top Last.fm genre tags (array) or null when not fetched.
